posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina Kaif delighted fans with her May photo dump featuring baby Vihaan's tiny hands and mushy pics with Vicky Kaushal, then turned up at sister Karisma Kapoor's 'Brown' screening with Saif Ali Khan.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit Dosanjh's Imtiaz Ali film Main Vaapas Aaunga hits cinemas June 12 with AR Rahman's music, while Badshah made a surprise appearance at his Dil-Luminati Tour London show performing 'Naina' together.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia Bhatt kicks off Alpha promotions for its July 3 release — the first female-led YRF Spy Universe film — and has joined the Tumbbad 2 cast for a powerful role shaping the horror franchise's future.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka Chopra confirms six months of shooting remain for SS Rajamouli's ₹1,300 crore epic Varanasi with Mahesh Babu, and is set to reprise her role as Priya in Hrithik Roshan's Krrish 4.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's action thriller King is confirmed for Christmas 2026 with a massive star cast including Deepika, Abhishek Bachchan, and Anil Kapoor. A leaked on-set image of his rugged grey-shades look sent fans into a frenzy.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena Kapoor turned up with Saif Ali Khan at Karisma Kapoor's 'Brown' screening, calling her the 'absolute 90s Queen.' She's also in advanced talks to reunite with Salman Khan in Raj & DK's superhero film.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha Kapoor is in talks for Maddock Films' grand mythological Mahavatar opposite Vicky Kaushal, while wrapping up the period musical Eetha where she plays a renowned Tamasha and Lavani performer.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika Padukone went viral doing Orry's signature pose with Ranveer Singh at a Goa family wedding in matching red outfits. She's gearing up for SRK's King, releasing Christmas 2026.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar 2 nears the ₹1,150 crore India net milestone in its 11th week, while the actor received an extortion threat prompting beefed-up security at his Dadar residence.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan has been named JW Marriott's Global Brand Ambassador, and turned heads at Cannes by recreating her iconic 2002 saree look with a bold sindoor statement that fans dubbed 'Operation Sindoor.'

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika Mandanna's Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor tops IMDb's most-anticipated Indian movie list for 2026, while she films a fierce villain turn in Allu Arjun and Atlee's mega sci-fi Raaka.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha Ruth Prabhu is in talks to star opposite Salman Khan in Raj & DK's quirky superhero film, building on her successful collaborations with the duo on The Family Man 2 and Citadel: Honey Bunny.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's mega VFX-heavy sci-fi spectacle Raaka with director Atlee is in full production — the Pushpa star plays multiple roles in what's being called the 'Avatar of India,' targeting a 2027 global release.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's rural sports drama Peddi smashes ₹150 crore worldwide in just 2 days after its June 4 release, with AR Rahman's music and a performance that's being compared to Virat Kohli's intensity.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR wished Dragon director Prashanth Neel on his birthday with a heartfelt note, fueling excitement for their June 2027 action epic. He also charmed fans by showing off his first-ever homemade chocolate chip cookies.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi Kapoor is at the center of a Peddi controversy as singer Sumangaly blasts the makers for the treatment of her character, while the Ram Charan-starrer crossed ₹125 crore in its opening weekend.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya Panday's Chand Mera Dil with Lakshya crossed ₹30 crore, and she graced the Filmfare May-June 2026 cover opening up about privilege, self-doubt, and choosing roles that challenge her.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: New mom Kiara Advani got candid about post-pregnancy body shaming, saying society goes from calling you a 'glowing goddess' to expecting instant fitness the moment the baby arrives.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik Roshan is shooting his directorial debut Krrish 4 this summer with a ₹350 crore budget, reuniting with Priyanka Chopra as the superhero saga eyes a late 2026 release under YRF and Rakesh Roshan.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun Dhawan's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai released June 5, marking legendary director David Dhawan's final film — a father-son farewell rom-com with Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal released devotional single 'Siddha Bhajo' as a heartfelt tribute to her father's spiritual influence, and announced massive US 'Unstoppable Tour' dates across 15+ cities this September.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman scored the music for Ram Charan's blockbuster Peddi and Imtiaz Ali's Main Vaapas Aaunga (June 12), reuniting the celebrated Imtiaz-Rahman-Irshad Kamil trio for what promises to be another iconic soundtrack.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay has been sworn in as Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister since May 2026 after his party's historic election win, while his final film Jananayagan's release is being planned for later this year.
